entities.summary: Radu Mircea Berceanu is a Romanian engineer and politician. A former member of the Democratic Liberal Party (PD-L), he was a member of the Romanian Chamber of Deputies for Dolj County from 1990 to 2004 and sat in the Romanian Senate from 2004 to 2012, representing the same county. In the Radu Vasile and Mugur Isărescu cabinets, he was Minister of Industry and Commerce from 1998 to 2000; in the first Călin Popescu-Tăriceanu cabinet, he was Minister of Transport, Construction and Tourism from 2006 to 2007; and in the Emil Boc cabinet, he was Minister of Transport and Infrastructure from December 2008 to September 2010.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a Romanian politician and engineer, Radu Berceanu held key ministerial positions from 1998 to 2010, contributing to Romania's economic development during this period. His tenure as Minister of Transport and Infrastructure had a notable impact on the country's infrastructure projects.
